item.title: Moving to Lincoln Park: The Park, DePaul, and Thirty-Four Inch Stairwells
item.description: What Lincoln Park is actually like to live in. Twelve hundred acres of lakefront park with a free zoo, the DePaul calendar that drives the whole neighborhood every August and May, and a housing stock that runs from narrow brownstone walk ups to high rises on the Drive. item.title: Moving to the Gold Coast: Freight Windows, Astor Street, and Why You Cannot Move on a Saturday
item.description: The Gold Coast is the one Chicago neighborhood where your move date is not entirely your decision. Freight elevator windows, limestone mansions on Astor with staircases built for a different era of furniture, and why January through March is the clearest stretch of the year here. Six oh six one zero and six oh six one one. Affordable City Movers, 3033 N Clark St, Suite 007, Chicago, IL 60657, 312-210-0259, affordablecitymovers.com
